hook.en: A partner dies in December, but the books close only in March. His family is entitled to his share of profit up to the date of *death*. How do we estimate it?
hook.kn: ಡಿಸೆಂಬರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಲುದಾರ ಮರಣ ಹೊಂದುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳು ಮಾರ್ಚ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತವೆ. ಮರಣದ ದಿನದವರೆಗಿನ ಲಾಭ ಅವನ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಬೇಕು. ಅದನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಅಂದಾಜು ಮಾಡುವುದು?

objectives.en: Calculate the deceased partner's share of profit on time and turnover basis
Record it through the Profit and Loss Suspense Account

narration.en: A partner dies in December, but the books close only in March. His family is entitled to his share of profit up to the date of death. How do we estimate it? We use the time basis or the turnover basis, and pay his executors.
narration.kn: ಡಿಸೆಂಬರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಲುದಾರ ಮರಣ ಹೊಂದುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳು ಮಾರ್ಚ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತವೆ. ಮರಣದ ದಿನದವರೆಗಿನ ಲಾಭ ಅವನ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಬೇಕು. ಅದನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಅಂದಾಜು ಮಾಡುವುದು? ಕಾಲ ಆಧಾರ ಅಥವಾ ವಹಿವಾಟು ಆಧಾರ ಬಳಸಿ, ಅವನ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಾಹಕರಿಗೆ ಪಾವತಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

title.en: Calculate the deceased partner's share of profit on time and turnover basis
Record it through the Profit and Loss Suspense Account

say.en: A partner dies in December, but the books close only in March. His family is entitled to his share of profit up to the date of death. How do we estimate it? We use the time basis or the turnover basis, and pay his executors. In this lesson: Calculate the deceased partner's share of profit on time and turnover basis.
Record it through the Profit and Loss Suspense Account.
Prepare the executor's account.

title.en: Profit up to the date of death

body.en: Time basis: previous year's (or average) profit × months up to death ÷ 12 × deceased's share. Turnover basis: find profit as a percentage of last year's sales, apply it to sales up to the *date of death*, and take his share. Entry: Profit and Loss Suspense A/c Dr, To Deceased Partner's Capital A/c. The suspense account is closed to the Profit and Loss Account at year end.
body.kn: ಕಾಲ ಆಧಾರ: ಹಿಂದಿನ ವರ್ಷದ ಲಾಭ × ಮರಣದವರೆಗಿನ ತಿಂಗಳು ÷ 12 × ಮೃತನ ಪಾಲು. ವಹಿವಾಟು ಆಧಾರ: ಮಾರಾಟದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಲಾಭದ ಶೇಕಡಾವನ್ನು ಮರಣದವರೆಗಿನ ಮಾರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿ. ನಮೂದು: ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಸಸ್ಪೆನ್ಸ್ ಖಾತೆ ಖರ್ಚು, ಮೃತ ಪಾಲುದಾರನ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ.

problem.en: A, B and C share 3:2:1. C dies on 30 June 2024. Books close on 31 March. Last year's profit was ₹1,20,000. Find C's share of profit on time basis and pass the entry.

steps.en: Profit and Loss Suspense A/c Dr 5,000; To C's Capital A/c 5,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A, B and C share 3:2:1. C dies on 30 June 2024. Books close on 31 March. Last year's profit was ₹1,20,000. Find C's share of profit on time basis and pass the entry.

say.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A, B and C share 3:2:1. C dies on 30 June 2024. Books close on 31 March. Last year's profit was 1,20,000 rupees. Find C's share of profit on time basis and pass the entry.
Months from 1 April to 30 June equals 3.
Profit for 3 months equals 1,20,000 times 3 over 12 equals 30,000 rupees.
C's share equals 30,000 times 1 over 6 equals 5,000 rupees.
Profit and Loss Suspense A over c Dr 5,000; To C's Capital A over c 5,000.
So the answer is 5,000 rupees.

problem.en: Same firm. Last year's sales were ₹16,00,000 and profit ₹2,40,000. Sales from 1 April to 30 June were ₹4,00,000. Find C's share on turnover basis.

steps.en: Profit to date of death = 15% of 4,00,000 = ₹60,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Same firm. Last year's sales were ₹16,00,000 and profit ₹2,40,000. Sales from 1 April to 30 June were ₹4,00,000. Find C's share on turnover basis.

say.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Same firm. Last year's sales were 16,00,000 rupees and profit 2,40,000 rupees. Sales from 1 April to 30 June were 4,00,000 rupees. Find C's share on turnover basis.
Profit rate equals 2,40,000 over 16,00,000 equals 15 percent of sales.
Profit to date of death equals 15 percent of 4,00,000 equals 60,000 rupees.
C's share equals 60,000 times 1 over 6 equals 10,000 rupees.
So the answer is 10,000 rupees.
